test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT with regard to the Green Revolution?

options.text: It was funded by international agencies.
It was introduced in areas that were rain-fed.
It was targeted mainly at the wheat and rice-growing areas.
It was a government programme of agricultural modernisation.

solution:
The correct answer is__** It was introduced in areas that were Rain-fed**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Green Revolution** a government-led agricultural modernization initiative,** focused on high-yielding varieties **of wheat and rice in irrigated regions, **not on rain-fed areas.**
 
• Its goal was to **increase food production through the use of fertilizers, pesticides, and advanced agricultural technologies.**
 
• While it significantly **boosted crop outputs **in targeted areas, the emphasis was not on rain-dependent agricultural zones.
 
• The **first phase of the green revolution** took place during the period ranging from the** mid-1960s up to the mid-1970s.**
 
• During the first phase, the **use of HYV seeds was restricted** to the more affluent states like Punjab, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu. 
 
• During the **second phase of the green revolution** (the mid-**1970s to mid-1980s**), the HYV technology spread to a larger number of states and benefitted more variety of crops.
 
• The **adoption of green revolution technology** enabled India to** achieve self-sufficiency in the production of food grains​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Facts about the Green Revolution**

 
 
• **​**​**M.S. Swaminathan** is known as the **father of the green revolution in India.**
 
• The green revolution was a** great success and changed India’s status from a food-deficient economy** to one of the world’s leading agricultural economies.
 
• The green revolution in India started in the year 1**965-68 and lasted till the year 1977-78.**
